name: ios-product-dev
title: iOS product development
description: Own end-to-end native iOS product work in SwiftUI while preserving Companion's shared API, authorization, accessibility, and runtime boundaries.
notes:
## What it does

This is the native iOS product owner for Companion. It shapes user-visible behavior, coordinates cross-platform design with design-frontend-dev, routes SwiftUI mechanics to swiftui-expert-dev, and verifies changes with xcodebuildmcp-cli.

## Scope

It covers the SwiftUI app and its zero-dependency CompanionKit package. It preserves full /v1 product parity, role-aware durable state, native iOS 26 presentation, and accessibility. It does not own the cross-platform design register, replace SwiftUI implementation expertise, or run build tools directly.

changes: Add the repo-local native iOS product owner for Agents and Claude.
